entities.name: Jozef Daňo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jozef Daňo is a Slovak former professional ice hockey player. He competed in the men's tournaments at the 1994 Winter Olympics and the 1998 Winter Olympics. His son, Marko Daňo, also plays ice hockey.
